head: 5be88f95aad9fe3f27c6e1f3f5dbc636c8c7fb35
reasons: Structure: one h1 in Hero.tsx, then h2 per section and h3 inside beats, problems, steps and plans. The footer h2 'Site links' is sr-only. The removed eyebrows left no heading gaps.

Text alternatives: every Panel in ProductPanel.tsx is role=img with a specific aria-label, innards aria-hidden. Safety icons removed; remaining icons are aria-hidden. The wordmark img has alt 'LinkedIn Engagement Manager'.

Contrast, computed by hand from index.css tokens: light fg-muted #5b6670 on page #f9f9f9 is about 5.6:1; dark fg-muted #a3aeb8 on #1f2c37 and #111a22 is above 6:1; light accent #054db1 on white about 8:1; the dark accent pairs pass. Field #7a8590 on white is about 3.7:1 and #7b8894 on #1f2c37 about 3.9:1, which clears 3:1 for borders and swatches.
Colour and meaning: status pills carry text; comparison marks carry sr-only 'included' / 'not included'; the mobile comparison list uses dl. The table has caption, th scope=col and th scope=row.

Keyboard: focus.json shows 30 stops at 1440 light, all visible_change true, no_visible_focus empty, in DOM order. The skip link is first and appears on focus. :focus-visible is a 2px currentColor ring. FAQ buttons carry aria-expanded and aria-controls. The mobile menu button has aria-expanded, aria-controls and a state-aware label.
Label in Name (2.5.3): every CtaButton aria-label contains its visible text.
Target size: Hero, nav, FAQ and menu controls are min-h-11 or h-11 (44px). Footer links pass WCAG 2.2 2.5.8 spacing.
Overflow: layout.json shows overflowing empty and scroll_width equal to viewport_width at 1440, 768 and 390, both themes. Clipped text is sr-only nodes and the closed skip link only.
Reduced motion: index.css has a global prefers-reduced-motion block; scrollToSection also checks the media query.
Plain language: hero 17px at lg and 16px below, line measure about 68 characters (55 at 390).
residuals: NOT VERIFIED: the focus pass ran only at 1440x900 light. Dark and 390 focus were not captured.
NOT VERIFIED: tap-target sizes at 390 come from source classes only, not a measured dump.
NOT VERIFIED: reduced motion was not captured with the media feature emulated.
NOT VERIFIED: contrast was computed by hand, not by an automated checker run on the rendered pages.

Unconfirmed, WCAG 2.4.11 Focus Not Obscured: the nav is sticky top-0 (64px) and no scroll-padding-top or scroll-margin was found in the UI source. Confirm by tabbing backwards at 390 and 1440; if the bar hides the ring, add scroll-padding-top: 5rem on html.
Plan panel: the 70/20/10 bar tells segments apart by fill only; authority and promo fills are close in light mode. Text labels and aria-label carry the facts, so it passes.
The skip link focus state covers the wordmark in the sticky nav. Temporary and acceptable.
focus.json stops at 30 tab stops, so tab order past that is covered by source only.
The hero panel hides 'Posts publish only after you approve them' inside aria-hidden content; the hero body and safety section state it.
The Safety mechanism list uses spans, not headings, for the five titles. A screen-reader user cannot jump between them.
